content.introduction: On October 3, 2026, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's Economic Indicators Calendar lists several key economic reports scheduled for release. On Thursday, initial claims, construction data, ISM Manufacturing, multivariate core trend inflation, and the weekly economic index are all set for release. On Friday, the Employment Situation, economic heterogeneity indicators, manufacturing shipments and orders, and the New York Fed Staff Nowcast are scheduled. The sources do not provide information on events beyond this date.
